unit: Source-backed dimension decomposition through actual residue maps, function divisors, approximation, and actual basis powers

new_concrete_definitions.name: basisPoleCorrection
new_concrete_definitions.formula: sum of the actual polar divisors of all actual basis functions

new_concrete_definitions.name: RiemannDimension.mulEquiv
new_concrete_definitions.formula: L(A+div z) equiv_linear_Rat L(A), f -> f*z, inverse g -> g/z, z != 0

new_concrete_definitions.formula: sSup of actual set {degree(A)-ell(A) | A : Divisor M}

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: principalDegreeZero_of_zeroPoleDegrees
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: Constants have order zero everywhere; nonconstants use functionDivisor=zeroDivisor-poleDivisor and subtract identical actual fiber degrees.

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: RiemannDimension.zpow_mul_mem
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: Actual normalized order law puts each scaled function in the actual valuation ring.

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: RiemannDimension.mem_ker_residueMap
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: Actual residue zero iff maximal-ideal membership; positive normalized order removes exactly one unit of allowed pole order at P.

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: RiemannDimension.step
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: Explicit kernel equivalence with L(A), finite actual residue field, finite generation, rank-nullity.
consumers: all finite-dimensionality and dimension upper bounds

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: RiemannDimension.step_nat and aux
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: Natural multiplicity induction and finite-support effective-divisor induction; actual finite-dimensional dictionaries installed explicitly.

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: RiemannDimension.negativeSpace
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: A nonzero f in L(A) gives an effective A+div f. Its degree contradicts degree(A)<0 and principal degree zero.

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: RiemannDimension.finiteDimensional_L
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: Choose an actual place and subtract enough copies to get negative degree, then add the effective divisor back using aux.

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: RiemannDimension.ell_le_max
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: Actual nonzero member makes A linearly equivalent to effective; actual multiplication equivalence preserves ell and principal degree zero preserves degree.

closed_source_proof_adaptations.name: riemannEventuallyLinear_of_degree_approximation_basis
closed_source_proof_adaptations.proof: Basis count and degree polar(u)=N bound polar-multiple defects; actual approximation transfers the bound; attained integer supremum and actual nonzero functions yield eventual equality.

open_children.name: functionZeroPoleDegrees
open_children.type: forall f : M.K, Transcendental Rat f -> degree(functionZeroDivisor f) = finrank Rat(f) M.K and degree(functionPoleDivisor f) = finrank Rat(f) M.K
open_children.remaining_mathematics: Actual integral-closure chart prime factorization and sum of ramification times residue degrees.
consumers: riemannRochEventuallyLinear replacement, degree of polar(u) via Model.degree_u
open_children.not_parent_renaming: The type is the finite morphism fiber degree identity. It contains no L(A) or dimension parent.

open_children.name: riemannPolarApproximation
open_children.type: forall A : Divisor M, exists z : M.K, z != 0 and exists l : Nat, A+functionDivisor(z) <= l*functionPoleDivisor(M.u)
open_children.remaining_mathematics: At each regular place, evaluate the minpoly over Rat of the actual residue of u to get a vanishing function; at poles use the actual polar divisor; then induct over divisor coefficients.
consumers: riemannEventuallyLinear_of_degree_approximation_basis: transfer bounded defects from polar multiples to all divisors
open_children.not_parent_renaming: The conclusion gives an actual nonzero rational function and a pointwise divisor inequality. It has no dimension expression.

open_children.name: riemannBasisPowerLowerBound
open_children.type: (forall A : Divisor M, FiniteDimensional Rat L(A)) -> forall l : Nat, (l+1)*N <= ell(l*functionPoleDivisor(M.u)+basisPoleCorrection)
source: Belyi/CurveField/Riemann.lean:169-223, the explicit u^k*b_i argument inside exists_deg_sub_ell_nsmul_le
open_children.remaining_mathematics: Actual u^k*b_i membership from normalized orders, monomial independence using transcendence, tensor-like independence over Rat(u), and finite-dimensional rank comparison.
open_children.finite_dimensionality_parameter: Actual spaces, provided explicitly from functionZeroPoleDegrees through the closed local residue-map induction. This avoids any cycle.
open_children.actual_basis: functionBasis M = Module.finBasis Rat(M.u) M.K with M.finite_u installed locally
open_children.actual_correction: basisPoleCorrection M hDVR = sum_i functionPoleDivisor(functionBasis M i)
open_children.exact_count: Module.finrank Rat(M.u) M.K = N from Model.degree_u
consumers: riemannEventuallyLinear_of_degree_approximation_basis: uniform bound on defects of polar multiples
open_children.not_parent_renaming: This is a concrete lower bound for one explicit family of spaces from specified functions; it does not assert finiteness, the upper bound, or eventual linearity.
